not_assessed.label: not assessed
not_assessed.meaning: Nobody has looked. This is not a finding of any kind.

not_applicable.label: not applicable
not_applicable.meaning: The requirement does not arise for this position at this date.

missing.label: missing
missing.meaning: Evidence that should exist was not located.

insufficient.label: insufficient
insufficient.meaning: Evidence exists but cannot support the requirement.

partial.label: partial
partial.meaning: Evidence supports part of the requirement. Two partials never compose to sufficient.

conflicting.label: conflicting
conflicting.meaning: Claims contradict. Dominates every other verdict until a human resolution supersedes.

sufficient.label: sufficient
sufficient.meaning: The requirement is met by the cited evidence.

R1.label: R1 · existence and cost
R1.letter: Letter ¶1 — executed transaction documents supporting acquisition, share counts, price per share and settlement of funds
R1.meaning: Applies to every holding at every date.

R2.label: R2 · fair-value support
R2.letter: Letter ¶2 — fair value support as of this measurement date
R2.meaning: Applies to every holding at every date.

R3.label: R3 · unchanged-mark calibration
R3.letter: Letter ¶3 — management's assessment that the last round price remains representative at this date
R3.meaning: Applies when the mark did not move and material support is stale.

R4.label: R4 · realization support
R4.letter: Letter ¶4 — merger consideration, distribution notices or other support for proceeds received

R5.label: R5 · pro-forma identification
R5.letter: Letter, closing paragraph — identify any positions marked on a pro forma basis pending executed documentation
R5.meaning: A labelling requirement for pro-forma marks. Labelling correctly is not support.

expired.label: support existed and expired
expired.meaning: A document on file once covered this. Its own stated reliance window does not reach this measurement date, so it is out of date rather than absent. The letter asks the valuer who wrote it to re-issue.

never_located.label: no support has been located anywhere
never_located.meaning: It was searched for and not found, and no record says who holds it. There is nothing to re-date and nobody named to ask, so the letter goes to the company.

held_elsewhere.label: it exists, and the fund does not hold it
held_elsewhere.meaning: A record names the document and it is outside the fund's repository. The letter goes to whoever holds it, which is a different letter from the one asking a company to produce a document nobody can find.

insufficient_authority.label: the document exists and cannot carry this
insufficient_authority.meaning: Evidence is on file, and either whose word it is or whether it is signed falls short of what the requirement asks.

unresolved.label: a decision or a step is outstanding
unresolved.meaning: The evidence is on file and something a human owes has not been recorded yet.

SUPPORT_OUTSIDE_ITS_OWN_RELIANCE_WINDOW.label: support is outside its own reliance window
SUPPORT_OUTSIDE_ITS_OWN_RELIANCE_WINDOW.meaning: The source states the period it may be relied on for, and this measurement date is not in it. The evidence is on file and out of date.

NO_APPLICABLE_SUPPORT_NOT_LOCATED.label: no applicable support · the document was not located
NO_APPLICABLE_SUPPORT_NOT_LOCATED.meaning: It was searched for in the fund's repository and not found.

NO_APPLICABLE_SUPPORT_WITH_COUNSEL.label: no applicable support · the document is with counsel
NO_APPLICABLE_SUPPORT_WITH_COUNSEL.meaning: It exists, outside the fund's repository, in counsel's hands.

NO_APPLICABLE_SUPPORT_REFERENCED_LOCATIO.label: no applicable support · referenced, location unstated
NO_APPLICABLE_SUPPORT_REFERENCED_LOCATIO.meaning: A record refers to the document and states nowhere it can be found.

DOCUMENT_NOT_LOCATED.label: the document was not located
DOCUMENT_NOT_LOCATED.meaning: Searched for in the fund's repository and not found.

DOCUMENT_WITH_COUNSEL.label: the document is with counsel
DOCUMENT_WITH_COUNSEL.meaning: It exists and the fund does not hold it. Existence and cost is partial, not missing.

DOCUMENT_LOCATION_UNSPECIFIED.label: the document is referenced with no location
DOCUMENT_LOCATION_UNSPECIFIED.meaning: Custody has to be established before anyone can request it.

PRESS_CANNOT_SUPPORT_FAIR_VALUE.label: press cannot support a fair value
PRESS_CANNOT_SUPPORT_FAIR_VALUE.meaning: A published report of a round is not evidence of this fund's position in it. The article may be entirely accurate and still cannot carry the mark.

MANAGEMENT_ASSERTION_WITHOUT_PRIMARY_SOU.label: a management assertion with no primary source
MANAGEMENT_ASSERTION_WITHOUT_PRIMARY_SOU.meaning: The fund's own record of its own holding, with nothing outside it agreeing.

NON_BINDING_TERM_SHEET.label: a non-binding term sheet
NON_BINDING_TERM_SHEET.meaning: Terms nobody is committed to. An unsigned document is different evidence from a signed one.

PRO_FORMA_PENDING_EXECUTION.label: pro forma, pending execution
PRO_FORMA_PENDING_EXECUTION.meaning: The figures assume a closing that the corpus does not show as executed.

UNCOVERED_SECURITY_CLASS.label: no evidence covers the class the fund holds
UNCOVERED_SECURITY_CLASS.meaning: Something on file prices a class, and it is not this one. Priced class and held class are different facts.

CROSS_CLASS_POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED.label: a cross-class inference needs a recorded policy decision
CROSS_CLASS_POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED.meaning: Carrying a price from one security class to another is a valuation judgement, and no human has recorded it.

CLOSING_SET_PENDING.label: the closing set has not arrived
CLOSING_SET_PENDING.meaning: Executed documents are said to be coming and are not here yet.

MARK_UNCHANGED_WITH_STALE_SUPPORT.label: the mark did not move and its support is stale
MARK_UNCHANGED_WITH_STALE_SUPPORT.meaning: R3 · an unchanged carrying value needs a calibration statement once the evidence under it has aged.

NO_MANAGEMENT_BASIS_MEMO.label: the third party's memo, and no memo from management
NO_MANAGEMENT_BASIS_MEMO.meaning: Letter ¶2 asks for two things where a mark is based on something other than a financing round: the underlying source AND management's memo describing the basis of the mark. The valuer's memo is a real and authoritative half of that conjunction. The other half does not exist anywhere in this fund's records.

SETTLEMENT_WITHOUT_SHARE_TERMS.label: settlement confirmed, share terms not
SETTLEMENT_WITHOUT_SHARE_TERMS.meaning: Letter ¶1 asks for share counts, price per share AND settlement of funds. This evidences the third limb only: it proves the fund paid and says nothing about what the fund received. On its own an auditor could not establish the position from it.

OFF_CLASS_EVIDENCE_NOT_RELIED.label: evidence about a class the fund does not hold, not counted
OFF_CLASS_EVIDENCE_NOT_RELIED.meaning: A document on file prices a different security class from the one held. It is named rather than dropped — it is in scope, and it is what makes this holding cross-class — but pricing one class off another's evidence is a valuation-policy act and is not performed until that decision is recorded.

NO_SUPPORT_FOR_A_HELD_CLASS.label: every price that could support this mark is for a class the fund does not hold
NO_SUPPORT_FOR_A_HELD_CLASS.meaning: Not an absence of evidence: there are documents and they state prices, for a class this position is not. `insufficient` rather than `missing` for that reason. Any figure on file against the held class is a historic one — an original issue price restated in a later table — and what shares first sold for does not support what they are worth now. The derivation has always refused this case, and the verdict now agrees with it.

REQUEST_UPDATED_VALUATION.label: request an updated valuation
REQUEST_UPDATED_VALUATION.recipient: the valuer who issued the memo on file
REQUEST_UPDATED_VALUATION.meaning: The memo exists and its reliance window has closed. Ask for a re-issue as of this measurement date.

REQUEST_FROM_COMPANY.label: request from the company
REQUEST_FROM_COMPANY.meaning: Nothing on file covers this. Ask the company for the underlying document.

REQUEST_FROM_COUNSEL.label: request from counsel
REQUEST_FROM_COUNSEL.meaning: The document exists and counsel holds it.

REQUEST_WITH_LOCATION.label: establish custody, then request
REQUEST_WITH_LOCATION.meaning: A record refers to the document without saying where it is. Custody comes first.

REQUEST_EXECUTED_DOC.label: request the executed document
REQUEST_EXECUTED_DOC.meaning: What is on file is unsigned. Signed and proposed are different evidence.

REQUEST_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE.label: request primary evidence
REQUEST_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE.meaning: What is on file reports the event rather than being it.

REQUEST_SUPPORT_FOR_CLASS.label: request support for the class held
REQUEST_SUPPORT_FOR_CLASS.meaning: Evidence on file prices a different security class than the one the fund holds.

RECORD_VALUATION_POLICY_DECISION.label: record a valuation policy decision
RECORD_VALUATION_POLICY_DECISION.meaning: No letter goes out. A human owes a recorded judgement.

DRAFT_MANAGEMENT_ASSESSMENT.label: draft a management assessment
DRAFT_MANAGEMENT_ASSESSMENT.meaning: R3 · the unchanged mark needs a written calibration before it can close.

REQUEST_MANAGEMENT_BASIS_MEMO.label: request management's memo on the basis of the mark
REQUEST_MANAGEMENT_BASIS_MEMO.meaning: Letter ¶2 · what the mark is BASED ON. Deliberately not the same request as R3's calibration assessment, which is ¶3(b) and asks whether a last round price remains representative at a later date. Different paragraphs, different documents, different questions.
